# Nodewise

> India-based studio for website development and custom software development. We work with startups, new businesses, and B2B companies that need a professional site or internal software. Landing pages 12k-15k INR. Software from 25k+. Custom platforms quoted. Transparent INR pricing. Worldwide delivery.

Site: https://nodewise.cc
Contact: contact@nodewise.cc
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919446998827

## Who we help

- Starting businesses that need a first website or landing page
- B2B companies that need a conversion-focused site
- Teams that need custom software, portals, dashboards, or light automation

## Offer

- Website development: 12k-15k INR. B2B websites, landing pages, and first web presence.
- Custom software development: 25k+ INR. Web apps, portals, dashboards, light automation.
- Custom platforms: quoted. Multi-user software and integrations.
- Zero to MVP (side offer): ₹29,999 one-time, 10-14 days. Consult, core MVP, live responsive web app, source, docs, ownership, 2 revision rounds. Excludes complex enterprise integrations, native mobile apps, massive scalable cloud architecture.
